shimmer_surge.name: Shimmer Surge
shimmer_surge.description: The glass throws back the sun in burning sheets. Enemies gain +1 AC; Rune Shards increase by 50%; all rewards increase by 10%.

caravan_auction.name: Caravan Auction
caravan_auction.description: Every trader on the road has goods to move. Market prices fall by 10% and all rewards increase by 10%.

quiet_dunes.name: Quiet Dunes
quiet_dunes.description: The Flats are still and the hidden markets wake. Black-market prices fall by 20% and all rewards increase by 10%.

long_heat.name: The Long Heat
long_heat.description: The sun refuses to set. Enemies gain 10% HP, rests cost 5 more gold, and all rewards increase by 20%.
